drafted_from: tools/pin-files-by-content/tool-rows.json (tool:check-prose-against-its-writing-rules), do-work/verify-writing-profile.mjs, test/verify-writing-profile.test.mjs; the example was run on synthetic files
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check post.md against my writing profile and my review file, and tell me each finding by kind and position." It runs verify-writing-profile.mjs and reports checks_satisfied, review_required or known_failure.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads one prose file, your writing profile and an optional review file, and writes one new report file.
instructions: 1. Clone the Workshop repository and run npm install (the tool needs @noble/hashes).

2. Write your own writing profile (schema writing-profile-v1, document_role current_prose): the rejected wordings with their authority, the protected literals that must stay as they are, and any required section order. Never let the AI invent rules for you.
3. If you have reviews, give the review manifest (schema writing-review-v1) bound to the document's BLAKE3 and each paragraph's BLAKE3; leave --reviews out when there is none.

4. The AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: "tool:check-prose-against-its-writing-rules"} and runs: node tools/pin-files-by-content/do-work/verify-writing-profile.mjs --document post.md --profile profile.json --reviews reviews.json --out report.json (a new file).
5. Read {status, findings}: exit 0 checks_satisfied, 1 review_required or known_failure, 2 invalid. Zero findings is not approval of the writing.

worked_examples.title: A rejected phrase in a reviewed post
worked_examples.ask: Check post.md against my writing profile.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/pin-files-by-content/do-work/verify-writing-profile.mjs and run on synthetic files: post.md is "# Opening hours", a paragraph "We open at seven: every day." plus "Our bread is fresh.", and a paragraph "We are a world-class bakery."; profile.json rejects the text "world-class" (authority author_confirmed) and protects the literal "We open at seven: every day."; reviews.json holds a retain review for each of the 3 paragraphs bound to their BLAKE3. The AI runs: node tools/pin-files-by-content/do-work/verify-writing-profile.mjs --document post.md --profile profile.json --reviews reviews.json --out report.json
worked_examples.hands_back: {"status":"known_failure","findings":1} with exit 1. report.json holds status known_failure, blocks 3, current_block_reviews 3 and findings [{"kind":"known_rejection","rule_index":0}]. With the rejected word removed and no --reviews it prints {"status":"review_required","findings":3} (three unreviewed_current_block findings, block_index 0 to 2).
